THE STORM, AND HOW THIS TOWN SHOWS IT. Skyreach is the one settlement in Caelora whose entire economy is the weather: the masts, the docks, the Cradle and the Hall all live or die on where the wind is coming from. So the change canon asks for -- every settlement's dialogue moving as the region turns -- is not a layer painted on top here, it is the thing everybody was already talking about. Three tiers, in this order, first match wins:

  storm_rising    the shared Act 5 flag, if whoever owns the region-wide turn sets one. Skyreach reads it and does not set it.
  crest_6_taken   the Frost Crest, which means the player has been to the Observatory and knows what Meridian are doing. From here the town's worry has a shape.
  (default)       nineteen days of wind from the wrong quarter, and nobody able to say why.

The default tier is ALREADY the weather going wrong, because a player can walk in here before Frostmere and the boards on the walls say nineteen days either way. What the flags add is not the storm. It is the town working out that it is not weather.
